property.name: optionsetFieldControl
property.description-key: Specifies the column that this property is bound to.

property.name: allowClear
property.description-key: When enabled, clicking the selected option again clears the value.

property.name: useOptionColors
property.description-key: When enabled, options that have a color defined in the column metadata are rendered with that color. Options without a color fall back to the default theme.
